d: Nothing stands in the way of these parkour professionals.
These creative thinkers show there's more to to household items than meets the eye.
These inspirational movers and groovers are going with the flow.
Athletes of all kinds reach for new heights.
The Guys reach neck-breaking heights with a massive slip n slide. Then, they attempt to make the highest jump in Slovenia.
The Guys try to jump over a speeding train. Then, they figure out the best way to get out of a rock and a hard place.
The Guys make a dunking video with flame throwers. Then, they travel to Croatia for some cliff diving like you've never seen before,
A treadmill, an ATV, a wetsuit, and a wobbly track, what could go wrong? Then, the Guys get chased through a castle.
Skater turned stuntman Justice Hedenberg, Wushu master “JJ” Zengjiao Jian, slackliner Olga Henry, and extreme athlete KC Deane are featured
Longboarder Lotfi Lamalli, Musician Harry Mack, Skinboarder Amber Torreabla and Martial Artist Noah Fleder are featured
Bodybuilder and personality Jon Call, Ninja athlete Natalie Duran, Downhill skateboarder Amanda Caloia, and Juggler Josh Horton are featured
Karate athlete Kensei Emory, Ninja athlete and paramedic Davyon Hancox, Acrobat James Heugh and Paralympian and host Blake Leeper are featured.
A sourdough reindeer, miniature pottery, domino art, and more.
